name: herbora-workspace
description: Herbora - Ancient Wisdom & Modern Discovery Ayurvedic Platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules') && fs.existsSync('frontend/node_modules')) { try { fs.symlinkSync('frontend/node_modules', 'node_modules', 'junction'); } catch(e){} }"
